Package gui

Class SettingsController

java.lang.Object
gui.SettingsController
public class SettingsController extends Object
Controller class for the restaurant operation settings screen. Manage standard weekly opening hours and special date-specific opening hours. Allows restaurant managers to add, edit, remove shifts, and close the restaurant for specific days.
